create_organization: create a new organization with an alias and optional max budget via the organization new endpoint
list_organizations: list all organizations and verify each has budget info in the litellm budget table
add_member_to_organization: add a user as a member to an organization with a specified role like internal user
update_member_role: update an existing member role in an organization from internal user to org admin
delete_organization: delete an organization by its organization id and verify it is removed from the list
